grade3_math_proficient.label: Third graders proficient in math (proficient or above on the state math test)
grade3_math_proficient.source: Illinois State Board of Education, Illinois Report Card Public Data Set
grade3_math_proficient.note: Share of tested third graders who scored Proficient or Above Proficient on the Illinois Assessment of Readiness (IAR) math test. Illinois set new proficiency levels starting with the spring 2025 tests, and ISBE says not to compare those results with earlier years, so the figures start in 2024-2025. County figures combine every district with third graders, placed in the county ISBE lists for the district and weighted by third grade enrollment times the share tested. ISBE does not report a district's rate when fewer than 10 students were proficient (in 2025-2026) or tested; those districts are left out, which can raise a county's figure, and a county where they hold a quarter or more of third graders shows no value (7 in 2025-2026). The Illinois figure is built the same way from the same districts; ISBE's own statewide figure was 49.2% in 2025-2026.

chronic_absent_rate.label: Students chronically absent (missed 10% or more of school)
chronic_absent_rate.source: Illinois State Board of Education, Illinois Report Card Public Data Set
chronic_absent_rate.note: Share of students who missed 10% or more of school days, for any reason, excused or not. County figures cover elementary, high school and unit districts, placed in the county ISBE lists for the district and weighted by enrollment; charter schools that are their own districts and regional programs are left out, and so are districts whose figure ISBE suppresses. Each student attends one district, so overlapping elementary and high school districts do not count anyone twice. The Illinois figure is built the same way; ISBE's own statewide figure was 23.5% in 2025-2026. 2019-2020 is left out because school buildings closed in March 2020.
